questions.explanation: IAM Identity Center centrally manages workforce access across multiple accounts with SSO. Access Analyzer (A) audits sharing, Secrets Manager (B) stores secrets, and STS (D) issues temporary credentials.

questions.question: A university receives a grant to conduct research by using AWS services. The research team needs to make sure the grant money lasts for the entire school year. The team has decided on a monthly allocation that adds up to the total grant amount. Which AWS service or feature will notify the team if spending exceeds the planned amount?
questions.explanation: AWS Budgets tracks monthly allocations against the grant and notifies when actual or forecasted spend exceeds them. Cost Explorer (B) analyzes past spend, tags (C) categorize it, and cost categories (D) group it.

questions.question: A company has migrated its workload to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to optimize existing Amazon EC2 resources. Which AWS services or tools provide this functionality? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Cost Explorer (B) visualizes EC2 spend and usage trends while Compute Optimizer (D) recommends optimal instance types. Beanstalk (A) deploys apps, Detective (C) investigates security, and Billing Conductor (E) customizes bills.

questions.question: A company with multiple accounts and teams wants to set up a new multi-account AWS environment. Which AWS service supports this requirement?
questions.explanation: AWS Control Tower automates multi-account landing zones with guardrails and account provisioning. CloudFormation (A) templates infrastructure, Config (C) audits configuration, and VPC (D) networks resources.

questions.question: A company needs access to checks and recommendations that help the company follow AWS best practices for cost optimization, security, fault tolerance, performance, and service quotas. Which combination of an AWS service and AWS Support plan on the AWS account will meet these requirements?
options: AWS Trusted Advisor with AWS Developer Support
AWS Health Dashboard with AWS Enterprise Support
AWS Trusted Advisor with AWS Business Support
AWS Health Dashboard with AWS Enterprise On-Ramp Support
questions.explanation: Full Trusted Advisor best-practice checks across all five categories require Business Support or higher. Developer Support (A) exposes only core checks, and Health Dashboard options (B, D) track service events rather than account best practices.

questions.question: Which AWS service helps users plan and track their server and application inventory migration data to AWS?
questions.explanation: Migration Hub centralizes tracking of server and application inventory migration data. CloudWatch (A) monitors metrics, DataSync (B) moves files, and Application Migration Service (D) rehosts servers.

questions.question: Which AWS team or offering helps users accelerate cloud adoption through paid engagements in any of several specialty practice areas?
questions.explanation: AWS Professional Services delivers paid consulting engagements across specialty practices to accelerate adoption. Enterprise Support (A) provides support plans, solutions architects (B) advise, and account managers (D) manage relationships.

questions.question: A company needs to purchase Amazon EC2 instances to support an application that will run continuously for more than 1 year. Which EC2 instance purchasing option meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
questions.explanation: Continuous use beyond one year earns the best pricing from Reserved Instances. Dedicated Instances (A) add isolation cost, Spot (B) can be interrupted, and On-Demand (D) has no discount.

questions.question: Which programming languages does AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) currently support? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: AWS CDK supports TypeScript (C), Python (A), Java, C#, and Go for defining infrastructure in familiar languages. Swift (B), Ruby (D), and PHP (E) are not CDK-supported languages.

questions.question: Which AWS service or feature gives users the ability to provision AWS infrastructure programmatically?
questions.explanation: The AWS CDK lets developers provision infrastructure programmatically using familiar languages that synthesize to CloudFormation. CodeGuru (B) reviews code, Config (C) audits resources, and CodeCommit (D) hosts Git repositories.

questions.question: Which AWS service or feature allows a company to have its own logically isolated section of the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation: Amazon VPC carves out a logically isolated network section of AWS where you define subnets, routing, and gateways. VPN (A) links networks, AZs (B) are failure-isolated data centers, and Regions (D) are geographic areas.

questions.question: Which of the following actions are controlled with AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)? (Choose two.)
options: Control access to AWS service APIs and to other specific resources.
Provide intelligent threat detection and continuous monitoring.
Protect the AWS environment using multi-factor authentication (MFA).
Grant users access to AWS data centers.
Provide firewall protection for applications from common web attacks.
questions.explanation: IAM controls which principals can call service APIs and access resources (A) and enforces MFA protection (C). Threat detection (B) is GuardDuty, data-center access (D) is AWS physical security, and WAF firewalling (E) is AWS WAF.

questions.question: Why are AWS CloudFormation templates used?
options: To reduce provisioning time by using automation.
To transfer existing infrastructure to another company.
To reuse on-premises infrastructure in the AWS Cloud.
To deploy large infrastructure with no cost implications.
questions.explanation: CloudFormation templates automate provisioning so stacks deploy in minutes repeatably. They do not transfer ownership (B), reuse on-premises hardware (C), or remove cost implications (D).

questions.question: A company is using AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Who can manage the access keys of the AWS account root user?
options: IAM users in the same account that have been granted permission
IAM roles in any account that have been granted permission
IAM users and roles that have been granted permission
questions.explanation: Only the AWS account owner can manage root-user access keys; IAM users and roles can never administer root credentials. Options A through C incorrectly delegate root control to IAM principals.

questions.question: Which group shares responsibility with AWS for security and compliance of AWS accounts and resources?
questions.explanation: The shared responsibility model splits duties between AWS and the customer. Vendors (A), resellers (C), and ISPs (D) are not parties to the model.

questions.question: A company needs an event history of which AWS resources the company has created. Which AWS service will provide this information?
questions.explanation: CloudTrail event history lists created resources and who created them via API calls. CloudWatch (A) monitors metrics, Aurora (C) is a database, and EventBridge (D) routes events.

questions.question: A company wants to run relationship databases in the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use a managed service that will install the database and run regular software updates. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS is the managed relational service that installs engines and applies patches automatically. S3 (A) stores objects, EBS (C) attaches block storage, and DynamoDB (D) is NoSQL.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides a fully managed graph database for highly connected datasets?
questions.explanation: Amazon Neptune is the managed graph database for highly connected datasets. DynamoDB (A) is key-value, RDS (B) and Aurora (D) are relational.

questions.question: A company's cloud environment includes Amazon EC2 instances and Application Load Balancers. The company wants to improve protections for its cloud resources against DDoS attacks. The company also wants to have real-time visibility into any DDoS attacks. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Shield Advanced adds EC2 and ALB DDoS protection with real-time attack visibility and cost protection. Shield Standard (A) covers basic L3/L4 only, Firewall Manager (B) manages WAF rules, and GuardDuty (D) detects threats.

questions.question: A company wants to update its online data processing application by implementing container-based services that run for 4 hours at a time. The company does not want to provision or manage server instances. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Fargate runs containers for hours-long jobs without provisioning servers. Lambda (A) caps executions at 15 minutes, EC2 (C) needs server management, and Beanstalk (D) manages servers behind apps.

questions.question: Which AWS service enables users to create copies of resources across AWS Regions?
questions.explanation: CloudFormation StackSets deploy the same template copies across Regions from one operation. ElastiCache (A) caches data, CloudTrail (C) audits APIs, and Systems Manager (D) manages operations.

questions.question: Which task is the responsibility of AWS, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Apply guest operating system patches to Amazon EC2 instances.
Provide monitoring of human resources information management (HRIM) systems.
Perform automated backups of Amazon RDS instances.
Optimize the costs of running AWS services.
questions.explanation: AWS automates RDS backups including snapshots and point-in-time recovery as part of the managed service. Guest OS patching (A) is customer duty on EC2, HRIM monitoring (B) is customer business, and cost optimization (D) is customer FinOps.

questions.question: A user needs to perform a one-time backup of an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that is attached to an Amazon EC2 instance. What is the MOST operationally efficient way to perform this backup?
options: Attach another EBS volume to the EC2 instance, and copy the contents.
Copy the EBS volume to a server that is running outside AWS and is connected with AWS Direct Connect.
Create an EBS snapshot of the volume.
Create a custom script to copy the EBS file contents to Amazon S3.
questions.explanation: An EBS snapshot captures a point-in-time backup to S3 in one API call, the most operationally efficient method. Attaching volumes (A), copying offsite (B), or scripting file copies (D) all add manual steps.

questions.question: A developer who has no AWS Cloud experience wants to use AWS technology to build a web application. Which AWS service should the developer use to start building the application?
questions.explanation: Amazon Lightsail bundles simple VPS instances, storage, and networking for beginners building web apps. SageMaker (A) trains ML, Lambda (B) runs functions, and ECS (D) orchestrates containers.

questions.question: A company wants to manage access and permissions for its third-party software as a service (SaaS) applications. The company wants to use a portal where end users can access assigned AWS accounts and AWS Cloud applications. Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
options: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory
questions.explanation: IAM Identity Center federates SaaS apps and AWS accounts behind one user portal with centralized access management. Cognito (A) serves app end users, IAM (C) manages AWS permissions directly, and Directory Service (D) hosts directories.

questions.question: Which AWS service is designed for users running workloads that include a NoSQL database?
questions.explanation: Amazon DynamoDB is the managed NoSQL key-value and document database. RDS (A) is relational, S3 (B) is object storage, and Redshift (C) is a warehouse.

questions.question: A company has a website on AWS. The company wants to deliver the website to a worldwide audience and provide low-latency response times for global users. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: CloudFront caches the website at edge locations worldwide for low-latency delivery. CloudFormation (A) provisions infrastructure, ElastiCache (C) caches database reads, and DynamoDB (D) stores data.

questions.question: A company wants to add a conversational chatbot to its website. Which AWS service can the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Amazon Lex builds conversational chatbots with speech and text understanding. Textract (A) extracts document text, Glue (C) runs ETL, and Rekognition (D) analyzes images.

questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can be used to monitor for potential disk write spikes on a system that is running on Amazon EC2?
questions.explanation: CloudWatch monitors EC2 disk and system metrics such as write spikes with alarms. CloudTrail (A) audits APIs, Health Dashboard (B) tracks service events, and Trusted Advisor (C) checks best practices.

questions.question: A company has applications that control on-premises factory equipment. Which AWS service should the company use to run these applications with the LEAST latency?
questions.explanation: AWS Outposts places AWS racks on premises next to factory equipment for least-latency control. EC2 (B) runs in distant Regions, Lambda (C) runs event functions, and Fargate (D) runs containers.

questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective focuses on organizing an inventory of data products in a data catalog?
questions.explanation: The CAF governance perspective catalogs data products and manages data governance. Operations (A) runs workloads, business (C) drives value, and platform (D) delivers infrastructure.

questions.question: A company runs its production workload in the AWS Cloud. The company needs to choose one of the AWS Support Plans. Which of the AWS Support Plans will meet these requirements at the LOWEST cost?
questions.explanation: Business Support is the cheapest plan offering 24/7 production-workload support with full Trusted Advisor checks. Developer (A) lacks production SLAs, and Enterprise plans (B, C) cost far more with TAMs.

questions.question: What is the primary use case for Amazon GuardDuty?
options: Automatic monitoring for threats to AWS workloads
questions.explanation: Amazon GuardDuty automatically monitors CloudTrail, VPC flow, and DNS logs with ML to detect threats to workloads. DDoS prevention (A) is Shield, SQL-injection protection (B) is WAF, and provisioning (D) is CloudFormation.

questions.question: Which VPC component can a company use to set up a virtual firewall at the Amazon EC2 instance level?
questions.explanation: Security groups provide stateful virtual firewalls at the instance (ENI) level. NACLs (A) filter subnets, route tables (C) direct traffic, and NAT gateways (D) enable outbound internet access.

questions.question: A developer needs to interact with AWS by using the AWS CLI. Which security feature or AWS service must be provisioned in the developer's account to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: CLI authentication requires an IAM access key ID and secret access key for programmatic signatures. User passwords (A) suit console login, Systems Manager (B) manages operations, and root passwords (C) must never be used for daily CLI work.

questions.question: A food delivery company needs to block users in certain countries from accessing its website. Which AWS service should the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: AWS WAF geo-match rules block requests by country on CloudFront, ALB, and API Gateway. Control Tower (B) manages accounts, Fraud Detector (C) scores fraud, and Pinpoint (D) sends engagement messages.

questions.question: A company needs to use Amazon S3 to store audio files that are each 5 megabytes in size. The company will rarely access the files, but the company must be able to retrieve the files immediately. Which S3 storage class will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
questions.explanation: S3 Standard-IA costs less for rarely accessed objects while keeping immediate millisecond retrieval. Standard (A) overpays for rare access, while Glacier Flexible and Deep Archive (C, D) add minutes-to-hours retrieval delays.

questions.question: A company wants to set up a secure network connection from on premises to the AWS Cloud within 1 week. Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Site-to-Site VPN establishes an encrypted connection over the internet within days, meeting the one-week deadline. Direct Connect (A) takes weeks to provision circuits, VPC (B) is a network container, and edge locations (D) cache content.

questions.question: What is a customer responsibility under the AWS shared responsibility model when using AWS Lambda?
options: Maintenance of the underlying Lambda hardware.
Maintenance of the Lambda networking infrastructure.
The code and libraries that run in the Lambda functions.
questions.explanation: On Lambda, customers own the function code and libraries while AWS manages hardware, networking, and runtimes. Options A, B, and D are all AWS-managed layers.

questions.question: Which tasks are the responsibility of AWS according to the AWS shared responsibility model? (Choose two.)
options: Configure AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).
Configure security groups on Amazon EC2 instances.
Secure the access of physical AWS facilities.
Patch applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances.
questions.explanation: AWS secures physical facilities (C) and performs infrastructure patching and maintenance (E). IAM configuration (A), security groups (B), and EC2 application patching (D) are customer duties.

questions.question: A company's compliance officer wants to review the AWS Service Organization Control (SOC) reports. Which AWS service or feature should the compliance officer use to complete this task?
questions.explanation: AWS Artifact hosts on-demand SOC and other compliance reports. Concierge Support (B) handles billing, Support (C) handles cases, and Trusted Advisor (D) checks best practices.

questions.question: A company has a compliance requirement to record and evaluate configuration changes, as well as perform remediation actions on AWS resources. Which AWS service should the company use?
questions.explanation: AWS Config records configuration changes, evaluates rules, and triggers remediation actions. Secrets Manager (B) stores secrets, CloudTrail (C) audits API calls, and Trusted Advisor (D) checks best practices.

questions.question: A company plans to perform a one-time migration of a large dataset with millions of files from its on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. Which AWS service should the company use for the migration?
questions.explanation: AWS DataSync migrates millions of files with scheduling, validation, and bandwidth controls. DMS (A) migrates databases, Migration Hub (C) tracks status, and Application Migration Service (D) rehosts servers.

questions.question: Which AWS network services or features allow CIDR block notation when providing an IP address range? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Security group rules (A) and network ACL rules (C) both accept CIDR notation for source and destination ranges. AMIs (B) are machine images, Budgets (D) track spend, and EBS (E) is block storage.

questions.question: A company wants to develop an accessibility application that will convert text into audible speech. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Amazon Polly converts text to lifelike speech for accessibility applications. MQ (A) brokers messages, Neptune (C) is a graph database, and Timestream (D) stores time series.

questions.question: A company needs to set up dedicated network connectivity between its on-premises data center and the AWS Cloud. The network cannot use the public internet. Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Direct Connect provisions a private dedicated line that bypasses the public internet. Transit Gateway (A) routes VPCs, VPN (B) traverses the internet, and CloudFront (C) caches content.

questions.question: A company needs to use dashboards and charts to analyze insights from business data. Which AWS service will provide the dashboards and charts for these insights?
questions.explanation: Amazon QuickSight builds dashboards and charts with ML insights from business data. Macie (A) finds PII, Aurora (B) is a database, and CloudTrail (D) audits APIs.

questions.question: A company wants to migrate its on-premises infrastructure to the AWS Cloud. Which advantage of cloud computing will help the company reduce upfront costs?
options: Benefit from massive economies of scale
Trade fixed expense for variable expense
questions.explanation: Trading fixed capex for variable pay-as-you-go expense removes upfront costs. Global reach (A), agility (B), and economies of scale (C) are separate benefits.

questions.question: A company is designing workloads in the AWS Cloud. The company wants the workloads to perform their intended function correctly and consistently throughout their lifecycle. Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework does this goal represent?
questions.explanation: Performing intended functions correctly and consistently is the reliability pillar's definition. Operational excellence (A) runs workloads well, security (B) protects data, and performance efficiency (D) uses resources efficiently.

questions.question: Which AWS service is used to temporarily provide federated security credentials to access AWS resources?
questions.explanation: AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) issues temporary federated credentials for roles and IdP users. GuardDuty (A) detects threats, Secrets Manager (C) stores long-lived secrets, and Certificate Manager (D) provisions TLS certificates.

questions.question: What is a benefit of using an Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) load balancer with applications running in the AWS Cloud?
options: An ELB will automatically scale resources to meet capacity needs.
An ELB can balance traffic across multiple compute resources.
An ELB can span multiple AWS Regions.
An ELB can balance traffic between multiple internet gateways.
questions.explanation: Elastic Load Balancing distributes incoming traffic across multiple targets such as EC2 instances and containers. Auto Scaling (A) adjusts capacity, load balancers operate within Regions (C), and they route to targets rather than between gateways (D).

questions.question: A company needs to convert video files and audio files to a format that will play on smartphones. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Amazon Elastic Transcoder converts media files into smartphone-compatible formats. Comprehend (A) analyzes text, Rekognition (B) analyzes images, and Polly (D) synthesizes speech.

questions.question: A company wants to securely store Amazon RDS database credentials and automatically rotate user passwords periodically. Which AWS service or capability will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Secrets Manager stores RDS credentials encrypted and rotates them automatically on schedules. S3 (A) stores objects, Parameter Store (B) lacks native RDS rotation, and CloudTrail (D) audits APIs.

questions.question: A company needs to have the ability to set up infrastructure for new applications in minutes. Which advantage of cloud computing will help the company meet this requirement?
options: Trade fixed expense for variable expense
questions.explanation: Provisioning infrastructure in minutes demonstrates increased speed and agility. Fixed-to-variable expense (A) concerns pricing, global reach (B) concerns geography, and capacity guessing (D) concerns scaling.

questions.question: A company needs a managed NFS file system that the company can use with its AWS compute resources. Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon EFS provides managed NFS file systems for EC2 and container compute. EBS (A) attaches block storage to one instance, Tape Gateway (B) archives to Glacier, and Glacier Flexible Retrieval (C) is archival object storage.

questions.question: A company plans to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to gather information about its on-premises data center. Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Application Discovery Service collects on-premises server inventory, configuration, and utilization for migration planning. DataSync (B) moves files, Storage Gateway (C) bridges storage, and DMS (D) migrates databases.

questions.question: Which tasks are responsibilities of the customer, according to the AWS shared responsibility model? (Choose two.)
options: Encrypt data and maintain data integrity.
Patch the Amazon RDS operating system.
Maintain identity and access management controls.
questions.explanation: Customers encrypt data and preserve its integrity (B) and maintain IAM controls (D). The virtualization layer (A), RDS OS patching (C), and AZ security (E) are AWS duties.

questions.question: An online retail company wants to migrate its on-premises workload to AWS. The company needs to automatically handle a seasonal workload increase in a cost-effective manner. Which AWS Cloud features will help the company meet this requirement? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Seasonal spikes are handled cost-effectively by pay-as-you-go pricing with no idle cost (B) plus Auto Scaling policies that add capacity automatically (D). Cross-Region deployment (A), CloudTrail audits (C), and centralized logging (E) do not themselves scale cost-effectively.

questions.question: A developer needs to use a standardized template to create copies of a company's AWS architecture for development, test, and production environments. Which AWS service should the developer use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: CloudFormation templates standardize architectures so identical dev, test, and production copies deploy repeatably. Cloud Map (A) registers services, CloudFront (C) delivers content, and CloudTrail (D) audits APIs.

questions.question: Which AWS service can create a private network connection from on premises to the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation: Direct Connect establishes a private dedicated connection from on premises to AWS. Config (A) audits resources, VPC (B) is a cloud network container, and Route 53 (C) resolves DNS.

questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which of the following is a responsibility of the customer?
options: Shred disk drives before they leave a data center.
Prevent customers from gathering packets or collecting traffic at the hypervisor level.
Patch the guest operating system with the latest security patches.
Maintain security systems that provide physical monitoring of data centers.
questions.explanation: Customers patch guest operating systems on EC2 with the latest security updates. Disk shredding (A), hypervisor isolation (B), and data-center monitoring (D) are AWS physical and platform duties.

questions.question: Which AWS service uses speech-to-text conversion to help users create meeting notes?
questions.explanation: Amazon Transcribe converts speech to text for meeting notes and subtitles. Polly (A) does the reverse, Textract (B) extracts document text, and Rekognition (C) analyzes images.

questions.question: Which AWS service or tool provides users with a graphical interface that they can use to manage AWS services?
questions.explanation: The AWS Management Console is the browser-based graphical interface for managing services. Copilot (A) deploys containers via CLI, the CLI (B) is command-line, and SDKs (D) are code libraries.

questions.question: A company has a workload that will run continuously for 1 year. The workload cannot tolerate service interruptions. Which Amazon EC2 purchasing option will be MOST cost-effective?
questions.explanation: A continuous non-interruptible 1-year workload gets the deepest 1-year RI discount by paying All Upfront. Partial Upfront (B) discounts less, Dedicated Instances (C) add isolation cost, and On-Demand (D) has no discount.

questions.question: A company migrated its systems to the AWS Cloud. The systems are rightsized, and a security review did not reveal any issues. The company must ensure that additional developments, integrations, changes, and system usage growth do not jeopardize this optimized AWS infrastructure. Which AWS service should the company use to report ongoing optimization and security?
questions.explanation: Trusted Advisor continuously reports optimization, security, and best-practice deviations as infrastructure evolves. Health Dashboard (B) tracks service events, Connect (C) is a contact center, and Systems Manager (D) manages operations.

questions.question: Which AWS service integrates with other AWS services to provide the ability to encrypt data at rest?
questions.explanation: AWS KMS provides centrally managed keys that integrate with S3, EBS, RDS, and other services for at-rest encryption. ACM (B) provisions TLS certificates, IAM (C) manages permissions, and Security Hub (D) aggregates findings.

questions.question: A company wants to track the monthly cost and usage of all Amazon EC2 instances in a specific AWS environment. Which AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Budgets tracks monthly EC2 cost and usage against limits with notifications. Cost Anomaly Detection (A) flags spikes, Compute Optimizer (C) recommends sizes, and Trusted Advisor (D) checks best practices.

questions.question: A company wants the ability to automatically acquire resources as needed and release the resources when they are no longer needed. Which cloud concept describes this functionality?
questions.explanation: Elasticity automatically acquires resources with demand and releases them when unneeded. Availability (A) keeps systems running, durability (C) prevents data loss, and reliability (D) withstands failure.

questions.question: A company wants a cost-effective option when running its applications in an Amazon EC2 instance for short time periods. The applications can be interrupted. Which EC2 instance type will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Spot Instances offer the cheapest short-term compute in exchange for possible interruption. On-Demand (B) costs more, Reserved (C) needs long commitments, and Dedicated (D) reserves hardware at a premium.

questions.question: A company has an AWS Business Support plan. The company needs to gain access to the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to help mitigate DDoS events. Which AWS service or resource must the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Shield Advanced includes DRT access for DDoS mitigation support. Shield Standard (A) offers basic automatic protection, Enterprise Support (B) is a separate costly plan, and WAF (C) filters application-layer requests.

questions.question: Which AWS service or tool provides a visualization of historical AWS spending patterns and projections of future AWS costs?
questions.explanation: Cost Explorer visualizes historical spend patterns and forecasts future costs with graphs and filters. CUR (A) exports raw line items, Budgets (B) alerts on thresholds, and CloudWatch (D) monitors operational metrics.

questions.question: A company is migrating to the AWS Cloud instead of running its infrastructure on premises. Which of the following are advantages of this migration? (Choose two.)
options: Elimination of the need to perform security auditing
Ability to deploy globally in minutes
Elimination of the cost of IT staff members
Redundancy by default for all compute services
questions.explanation: Migration gains global reach with agility (B) and worldwide deployment in minutes (C). Security auditing (A) remains shared, IT staff (D) take new roles rather than disappearing, and redundancy (E) must be architected per service.

questions.question: Which AWS service uses edge locations to cache content?
questions.explanation: CloudFront caches content at global edge locations. Kinesis (A) streams data, SQS (B) queues messages, and Route 53 (D) resolves DNS.

questions.question: A company wants to securely access an Amazon S3 bucket from an Amazon EC2 instance without accessing the internet. What should the company use to accomplish this goal?
questions.explanation: A gateway VPC endpoint connects EC2 to S3 privately without internet traversal. VPN (A) links on-premises, internet gateways (B) expose subnets publicly, and NAT gateways (D) allow outbound-only internet access.

questions.question: A company wants an AWS service that can automate software deployment in Amazon EC2 instances and on-premises instances. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: CodeDeploy automates software deployments to EC2 and on-premises instances with deployment strategies. CodeCommit (A) hosts Git, CodeBuild (B) compiles code, and CodePipeline (D) orchestrates the pipeline.

questions.question: Which AWS services are serverless? (Choose two.)
options: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka
questions.explanation: Fargate (A) runs containers and S3 (D) stores objects with no servers to manage, both serverless. MSK (B) and EMR (C) run managed clusters, and EC2 (E) needs server administration.

questions.question: A company wants to continuously improve processes and procedures to deliver business value. Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework does this goal represent?
questions.explanation: Continually improving processes to deliver business value is operational excellence. Performance efficiency (A) uses resources well, reliability (C) withstands failure, and sustainability (D) minimizes environmental impact.

questions.question: Which of the following is a customer responsibility according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Apply security patches for Amazon S3 infrastructure devices.
Provide physical security for AWS datacenters.
Install operating system updates on Lambda@Edge.
Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) for IAM user accounts.
questions.explanation: Customers must enforce MFA on their IAM users under shared responsibility. S3 device patching (A), data-center security (B), and Lambda@Edge OS updates (C) are AWS duties.

questions.question: Which AWS service should a company use to organize, characterize, and search large numbers of images?
questions.explanation: Amazon Rekognition organizes and searches image libraries with object, scene, and face analysis. Transcribe (A) converts speech to text, Aurora (C) is relational, and QuickSight (D) dashboards data.

questions.question: Which AWS service is always available free of charge to users?
questions.explanation: IAM has no charge for users, groups, roles, and policies. Athena (A) bills per query, Secrets Manager (C) bills per secret, and ElastiCache (D) bills for nodes.

questions.question: A company needs to run some of its workloads on premises to comply with regulatory guidelines. The company wants to use the AWS Cloud to run workloads that are not required to be on premises. The company also wants to be able to use the same API calls for the on-premises workloads and the cloud workloads. Which AWS service or feature should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Outposts extends identical AWS APIs on premises for regulated workloads alongside cloud workloads. Dedicated Hosts (A) isolate EC2 hardware, AZs (C) sit inside Regions, and Wavelength (D) embeds compute in telecom networks.

questions.question: What is the recommended use case for Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances?
options: A steady-state workload that requires a particular EC2 instance configuration for a long period of time
A workload that can be interrupted for a project that requires the lowest possible cost
An unpredictable workload that does not require a long-term commitment
A workload that is expected to run for longer than 1 year
questions.explanation: On-Demand suits unpredictable short-term workloads with no commitment. Steady long-term use (A) fits Reserved, interruptible cheapest cost (B) fits Spot, and multi-year runs (D) fit Reserved or Savings Plans.

questions.question: A company wants to use an AWS networking solution that can act as a centralized gateway between multiple VPCs and on-premises networks. Which AWS service or feature will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Transit Gateway hubs multiple VPCs and on-premises networks with central routing. Gateway endpoints (A) reach S3 and DynamoDB, Direct Connect (B) is a private line, and PrivateLink (C) exposes services privately.

questions.question: An administrator observed that multiple AWS resources were deleted yesterday. Which AWS service will help identify the cause and determine which user deleted the resources?
questions.explanation: CloudTrail logs which user deleted resources via API events with identity and timestamp. Inspector (B) scans vulnerabilities, GuardDuty (C) detects threats, and Trusted Advisor (D) checks best practices.

questions.question: To assist companies with Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance in the cloud, AWS provides:
options: physical Inspections of data centers by appointment.
required PCI compliance certifications for any application running on AWS.
an AWS Attestation of Compliance (AOC) report for specific AWS services.
questions.explanation: AWS publishes an Attestation of Compliance report for PCI DSS covering in-scope services via Artifact. Physical inspections (A) are not offered, AWS does not certify customer apps (B), and it does not provide professional PCI services (D).

questions.question: In which situations should a company create an IAM user instead of an IAM role?
options: When an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances requires access to other AWS services
When the company creates AWS access credentials for individuals
When the company creates an application that runs on a mobile phone that makes requests to AWS
When the company needs to add users to IAM groups
When users are authenticated in the corporate network and want to be able to use AWS without having to sign in a second time
questions.explanation: IAM users suit long-lived credentials for individual people; roles suit temporary access for apps, federation, and cross-account use. EC2 app access (A) uses roles, mobile apps (C) use Cognito federation, and corporate SSO (E) uses federation.

questions.question: A company hosts a web application on AWS. The company has improved the availability of its application by provisioning multiple Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to distribute its traffic across the EC2 instances while providing a single point of contact to the web clients. Which AWS service can distribute the traffic to multiple EC2 instances as targets?
questions.explanation: An Application Load Balancer fronts multiple EC2 targets behind one DNS endpoint distributing HTTP traffic. VPC endpoints (A) reach services privately, NAT gateways (C) allow outbound internet, and internet gateways (D) route subnets publicly.

questions.question: What is the total volume of data that can be stored in Amazon S3?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 scales to virtually unlimited total storage with per-object limits but no bucket cap. The petabyte figures (A, B, C) describe Snow or transfer devices rather than S3 capacity.

questions.question: Which design principle is related to the reliability pillar according to the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
questions.explanation: Testing recovery procedures with game days and backups is a core reliability principle. Experimentation (B) is operational excellence, global deployment (C) is a cloud benefit, and expenditure analysis (D) is cost optimization.

questions.question: A company stores data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Which task is the responsibility of AWS?
options: Protect the infrastructure that supports S3 storage.
questions.explanation: AWS protects the physical infrastructure behind S3 storage. Lifecycle policies (A), versioning (B), and bucket policies (C) are customer configurations.

questions.question: A company wants to transfer a virtual Windows Server 2022 that is currently running in its own data center to AWS. The company wants to automatically convert the existing server to run directly on AWS infrastructure instead of visualized hardware. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Application Migration Service (MGN) automatically converts on-premises servers to run natively on AWS EC2. DataSync (A) moves files, DMS (B) migrates databases, and Discovery Service (C) inventories servers.

questions.question: Which AWS service is a fully managed NoSQL database service?
questions.explanation: Amazon DynamoDB is the fully managed NoSQL key-value and document database. RDS (A) and Aurora (D) are relational, and Redshift (B) is a warehouse.

questions.question: A company deployed an application in multiple AWS Regions around the world. The company wants to improve the application’s performance and availability. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Global Accelerator routes multi-Region traffic through the AWS backbone to the nearest healthy endpoint, improving performance and availability. DataZone (B) governs data, Cloud Map (C) registers services, and Auto Scaling (D) adjusts capacity per Region.

questions.question: A company wants to migrate its on-premises SQL Server database to the AWS Cloud. The company wants AWS to handle the day-to-day administration of the database. Which AWS service will meet the company's requirements?
options: Amazon EC2 for Microsoft SQL Server
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS manages SQL Server with automated patching, backups, and failover. EC2 for SQL Server (A) leaves administration to you, DynamoDB (B) is NoSQL, and Aurora (D) supports MySQL and PostgreSQL only.

questions.question: A company needs stateless network filtering for its VPC. Which AWS service, tool, or feature will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Network ACLs provide stateless subnet-level filtering with separate inbound and outbound rules. PrivateLink (A) reaches services privately, security groups (B) are stateful instance firewalls, and WAF (D) filters web requests.

questions.question: Which option is an advantage of AWS Cloud computing that minimizes variable costs?
questions.explanation: Economies of scale spread infrastructure costs across all AWS users, minimizing everyone's variable cost. High availability (A), global reach (C), and agility (D) are separate benefits.

questions.question: A company wants to migrate its server-based applications to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to determine the total cost of ownership for its compute resources that will be hosted on the AWS Cloud. Which combination of AWS services or tools will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The Pricing Calculator (A) estimates future cloud costs and Migration Evaluator (B) builds TCO business cases from discovered on-premises inventory. Support Center (C) handles cases, Discovery Service (D) inventories servers, and DMS (E) migrates databases.

questions.question: A company has data lakes designed for high performance computing (HPC) workloads. Which Amazon EC2 instance type should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: HPC and data-lake compute need compute optimized instances with high vCPU throughput. General purpose (A) balances resources, memory optimized (C) suits in-memory work, and storage optimized (D) suits high I/O.

questions.question: Which benefits does a company gain when the company moves from on-premises IT architecture to the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)
options: Reduced or eliminated tasks for hardware troubleshooting, capacity planning, and procurement
Elimination of the need for trained IT staff
Automatic security configuration of all applications that are migrated to the cloud
Elimination of the need for disaster recovery planning
Faster deployment of new features and applications
questions.explanation: Cloud removes hardware troubleshooting, capacity planning, and procurement (A) and accelerates feature deployment (E). Staff (B) take new cloud roles, application security (C) remains shared, and DR planning (D) is still required.

questions.question: A company is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company is conducting organizational transformation and wants to become more responsive to customer inquiries and feedback. Which task should the company perform to meet these requirements, according to the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF)? (Choose two.)
options: Realign teams to focus on products and value streams.
Create new value propositions with new products and services.
Use agile methods to rapidly iterate and evolve.
Use a new data and analytics platform to create actionable insights.
questions.explanation: CAF people guidance says realign teams to products and value streams (A) and iterate with agile methods (C) to improve responsiveness. New value propositions (B) are business perspective, analytics platforms (D) are platform, and migration (E) is delivery execution.

questions.question: A company that is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud is based in an isolated area that has limited internet connectivity. The company needs to perform local data processing on premises. The company needs a solution that can operate without a stable internet connection. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Snowball Edge devices process data locally and operate offline in isolated areas without stable internet. S3 (A) needs connectivity, Storage Gateway (C) needs network links, and Backup (D) backs up AWS resources.

questions.question: A company wants to build graph queries for real-time fraud pattern detection. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Amazon Neptune is the managed graph database for real-time fraud-pattern relationship queries. DynamoDB (B) is key-value, Timestream (C) stores time series, and Forecast (D) predicts metrics.

questions.question: A company wants to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company needs the ability to acquire resources when the resources are necessary. The company also needs the ability to release those resources when the resources are no longer necessary. Which architecture concept of the AWS Cloud meets these requirements?
questions.explanation: Elasticity acquires resources when necessary and releases them when not. Availability (B) keeps systems running, reliability (C) withstands failure, and durability (D) prevents data loss.

questions.question: A company has moved all its infrastructure to the AWS Cloud. To plan ahead for each quarter, the finance team wants to track the cost and usage data of all resources from previous months. The finance team wants to automatically generate reports that contains the data. Which AWS service or feature should the finance team use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Budgets tracks past cost and usage data and auto-generates scheduled reports for quarterly planning. Detective (A) investigates security, Pricing Calculator (B) estimates future costs, and Savings Plans (D) discount compute.

questions.question: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective focuses on real-time insights and answers questions about strategy?
questions.explanation: The CAF business perspective uses real-time insights to answer strategy questions. Operations (A) runs workloads, people (B) transforms workforce, and platform (D) delivers infrastructure.

questions.question: A company wants to migrate critical on-premises production systems to Amazon EC2 instances. The production instances will be used for at least 3 years. The company wants a pricing option that will minimize cost. Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Critical 3-year production instances earn the deepest discount from multi-year Reserved Instances. On-Demand (A) has no discount, Spot (C) can be interrupted, and Free Tier (D) covers only small trial usage.

questions.question: Which AWS Well-Architected Framework concept represents a system's ability to remain functional when the system encounters operational problems?
questions.explanation: The intended reliability concept here is fault tolerance (remaining functional during problems); note the options list durability (C) as the keyed answer while the standard term is reliability/fault tolerance. Consistency (A), elasticity (B), and latency (D) describe other properties.

questions.question: Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework focuses on the ability to recover automatically from service interruptions?
questions.explanation: Automatic recovery from service interruptions is the reliability pillar's core goal. Security (A) protects data, performance efficiency (B) uses resources well, and operational excellence (C) runs workloads effectively.

questions.question: A company has multiple SQL-based databases located in a data center. The company needs to migrate all database servers to the AWS Cloud to reduce the cost of operating physical servers. Which AWS service or resource will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS manages SQL databases with automated patching and backups for least overhead. EC2 (A) leaves management to you, DynamoDB (C) is NoSQL requiring rewrites, and OpenSearch (D) searches text.

questions.question: A company wants to build, train, and deploy machine learning (ML) models. Which AWS service can the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Amazon SageMaker is the end-to-end managed platform for building, training, and deploying ML models. Personalize (A), Comprehend (B), and Forecast (C) are single-purpose ML services for recommendations, NLP, and forecasting.

questions.question: Which AWS service or tool provides recommendations to help users get rightsized Amazon EC2 instances based on historical workload usage data?
questions.explanation: Compute Optimizer analyzes CloudWatch history to recommend optimal EC2 types and sizes. The Pricing Calculator (A) estimates future costs, App Runner (C) runs container web apps, and Systems Manager (D) manages operations.

questions.question: A company wants to explore and analyze data in Amazon S3 by using a programming language. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon Athena runs SQL directly against S3 data, suiting programmatic exploration of S3 datasets. Kendra (A) searches documents, Comprehend (C) analyzes text, and SageMaker (D) trains ML models.

questions.question: A company needs to run an application on Amazon EC2 instances without interruption. Which EC2 instance purchasing option will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?
questions.explanation: On-Demand Instances guarantee uninterrupted capacity with no commitment, fitting workloads that cannot be interrupted but lack steady-state commitment. Reserved options (A, B) need long commitments, and Spot (D) can be interrupted.

questions.question: A company wants a fully managed service that centralizes and automates data protection across AWS services and hybrid workloads. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Backup centralizes and automates backup policies across AWS services and hybrid workloads. Artifact (A) hosts compliance reports, Batch (B) runs batch jobs, and Shield (D) mitigates DDoS.

questions.question: A company plans to migrate its application from on premises to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to gather usage and configuration data for the application components. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Application Discovery Service gathers on-premises application usage and configuration for migration planning. DMS (A) migrates databases, Transfer Family (B) transfers files, and Global Accelerator (D) optimizes traffic.

questions.question: Which design principle aligns with performance efficiency pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
questions.explanation: The keyed answer (A) reflects using serverless to avoid idle capacity, though the canonical performance-efficiency principles emphasize experimentation, mechanical sympathy, and scaling. Horizontal scaling (B) is also a valid efficiency pattern, while cost measurement (C) is cost optimization and managed services (D) span pillars.

questions.question: A company wants to provide low latency to its users around the world. Which feature of the AWS Cloud meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Worldwide low latency comes from global infrastructure with Regions and edge locations near users. Pay-as-you-go (B), managed services (C), and economies of scale (D) address pricing and operations rather than latency.

questions.question: Which type of workload should a company run on Amazon EC2 Spot Instances?
options: A steady-state workload that requires a particular EC2 instance configuration for a long period of time
A workload that can be interrupted and can control costs
A steady-state workload that does not require a long-term commitment
A workload that cannot be interrupted and can control costs
questions.explanation: Spot Instances suit interruptible workloads trading interruption risk for the lowest cost. Steady long-term use (A) fits Reserved, non-committal steady use (C) fits On-Demand, and non-interruptible needs (D) exclude Spot.

questions.question: A company has multiple AWS accounts. The company needs to receive a consolidated bill from AWS and must centrally manage security and compliance. Which AWS service or feature should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Organizations consolidates billing across accounts and centrally manages SCPs for security and compliance. CUR (A) exports line items, Config (C) audits configuration, and Security Hub (D) aggregates findings.

questions.question: For which use case are Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances MOST cost-effective?
options: Compute-intensive video transcoding that can be restarted if necessary
An instance in continual use for 1 month to conduct quality assurance tests
An instance that runs a web server that will run for 1 year
An instance that runs a database that will run for 3 years
questions.explanation: One month of continual QA testing fits On-Demand with no long-term commitment. Restartable transcoding (A) fits Spot, while 1-year and 3-year steady runs (C, D) fit Reserved Instances or Savings Plans.

questions.question: A company has developed a new In-house application. The company does not have a way to determine or predict the usage demand that the application will create. Which AWS Cloud computing benefit is the company seeking?
questions.explanation: Unknown demand seeks scalability and high performance that grows automatically. Ease of use (A), cost-effectiveness (B), and security (C) are separate benefits.

questions.question: Which AWS offering can analyze a company’s AWS environment to discover security vulnerabilities on Amazon EC2 instances?
questions.explanation: Amazon Inspector scans EC2 instances and container images for CVEs and network exposure. Macie (B) finds PII, Shield Standard (C) mitigates DDoS, and security groups (D) filter traffic.

questions.question: A company plans to onboard new employees that will be working remotely. The company needs to set up Windows virtual desktops to create a working environment for the new employees. The employees must be able access the working environment from anywhere and by using their computer or a web browser. Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon WorkSpaces delivers Windows virtual desktops accessible from anywhere via clients or browsers. Dedicated Hosts (A) isolate EC2 hardware, Global Accelerator (B) optimizes traffic, and CloudFront (D) caches content.

questions.question: A company wants to visualize and manage AWS Cloud costs and usage for a specific period of time. Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Cost Explorer visualizes and manages cost and usage over selected periods with graphs and forecasts. Consolidated billing (B) and Organizations (C) combine accounts, and Budgets (D) alerts on thresholds.

questions.question: Which AWS service supports MySQL database engines?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS supports MySQL among its engines. DynamoDB (A) is NoSQL, DocumentDB (C) is MongoDB-compatible, and ElastiCache (D) caches data in memory.

questions.question: A company purchased Amazon EC2 Standard Reserved Instances (RIs) for a workload in the AWS Cloud. The company needs to move part of the workload to an instance family that does not match the instance family of these Standard RIs. How can the company take advantage of the Standard RIs that it no longer needs?
options: Contact the AWS Support team, and ask the team to sell the Standard RIs
Sell the Standard RIs on the Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance Marketplace
Sell the Standard RIs as a third-party seller on the AWS Marketplace
Convert the Standard RIs to Savings Plans
questions.explanation: Unused Standard RIs can be listed and sold on the EC2 Reserved Instance Marketplace to other customers. Support (A) does not broker sales, Marketplace (C) sells software rather than RIs, and Standard RIs cannot convert to Savings Plans (D).

questions.question: A company is releasing a business-critical application. Before the release, the company needs strategic planning assistance from AWS. During the release, the company needs AWS infrastructure event management and real-time support. What should the company do to meet these requirements?
options: Sign up for AWS Enterprise Support
questions.explanation: Enterprise Support provides strategic planning guidance plus Infrastructure Event Management with real-time support during critical releases. Trusted Advisor (A) checks best practices, APN (B) connects partners, and Professional Services (D) delivers consulting projects.

questions.question: A company wants to improve employee productivity by providing a way for employees to search for questions and retrieve specific answers. The company wants to use a single intelligent search interface. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon Kendra provides intelligent enterprise search returning specific answers from documents. Connect (A) is a contact center, Lex (C) builds chatbots, and Comprehend (D) analyzes text without a search interface.

questions.question: A company wants an Amazon S3 solution that provides access to object storage within single-digit milliseconds. Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: S3 Express One Zone delivers single-digit-millisecond object access for latency-sensitive workloads. Standard (B) offers tens of milliseconds, while Glacier classes (C, D) target archival retrieval.

questions.question: A company runs an uninterruptible Amazon EC2 workload on AWS 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The company will require the same instance family and instance type to run the workload for the next 12 months. Which combination of purchasing options should the company choose to MOST optimize costs? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A fixed 24/7 workload on one instance family for 12 months gets the deepest fixed discount from Standard RIs (A) paid All Upfront (E) for the maximum prepayment discount. Convertible RIs (B) trade discount for flexibility, Compute Savings Plans (C) suit changing families, and Spot (D) can be interrupted.

questions.question: A company wants to run its application's code without having to provision and manage servers. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: AWS Lambda runs code without provisioning or managing servers. Glue (A) runs ETL jobs, CodeDeploy (C) deploys apps, and CodeGuru (D) reviews code.

questions.question: A company is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to understand the existing on-premises usage and configuration. The company does not want to replicate its workloads to AWS, yet. Which AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Application Discovery Service inventories on-premises usage and configuration without replicating workloads. Application Migration Service (B) rehosts servers, Cloud Migration Factory (C) orchestrates migrations, and Transfer Family (D) transfers files.

questions.question: A company wants to allow its employees to work remotely from home. The company's employees use Windows or Linux desktops. The company's employees need access from anywhere and at anytime by using any supported devices. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon WorkSpaces delivers persistent Windows or Linux virtual desktops accessible from anywhere on supported devices. AppStream 2.0 (B) streams apps sessionally, Keyspaces (C) is a database, and Cloud9 (D) is an IDE.

questions.question: A company wants to test a new application. Which AWS principle will help the company test the application?
options: Make long-term commitments in exchange for a cost discount.
Scale up and down when needed without any long-term commitments.
Have total control over the application infrastructure.
Manage all of the maintenance tasks associated with the cloud.
questions.explanation: Elasticity lets teams scale up and down for testing with no long-term commitments. Long-term commitments (A) suit steady production, total infrastructure control (C) is on-premises, and managing all maintenance (D) contradicts managed services.

questions.question: A company plans to launch an ecommerce website that contains many images for a product catalog. The company wants to keep the cost of running the website within a specific budget. Which AWS service or tool should the company use to monitor the ongoing costs of the website?
questions.explanation: Cost Explorer monitors ongoing website spend against budget with graphs and forecasts. SDKs (B) build apps, Image Builder (C) builds AMIs, and CloudFormation (D) provisions infrastructure.

questions.question: A company has deployed several public applications behind Application Load Balancers. The company wants to improve the performance of the applications. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Global Accelerator routes ALB traffic over the AWS backbone to the nearest healthy endpoint, improving performance. Connect (B) is a contact center, ElastiCache (C) caches database reads, and CloudWatch (D) monitors metrics.

questions.question: A company has an on-premises application. The application has processing times of less than 5 minutes and is invoked only a few times each day. The company wants to move the application to the AWS Cloud. Which AWS service will support this application MOST cost-effectively?
questions.explanation: Sub-5-minute runs a few times daily fit Lambda pay-per-invocation serverless execution. ECS (A) and EKS (C) run always-on containers, and EC2 (D) bills for idle servers between invocations.

questions.question: A company is learning about the perspectives of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF). Which perspective of the AWS CAF addresses the strategy management capability?
questions.explanation: The CAF governance perspective covers strategy management, benefits, and risk. Business (A) covers value realization, people (B) covers workforce, and operations (D) covers running workloads.

questions.question: A company wants to consolidate its call centers to improve the customer voice and chat experience with call center agents. Which AWS service or tool will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon Connect consolidates voice and chat contact centers with AI features. SNS (A) sends notifications, Support Center (B) handles support cases, and Cognito (C) authenticates users.

questions.question: A company needs to provision uninterruptible Amazon EC2 instances, when needed, and pay for compute capacity by the second. Which EC2 instance purchasing option will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: On-Demand Instances provide uninterruptible capacity billed per second with no commitment. Reserved (A) needs long commitments, Spot (B) can be interrupted, and Dedicated (D) reserves hardware at a premium.

questions.question: Which AWS service can migrate Amazon EC2 instances from one AWS Region to another?
questions.explanation: Application Migration Service (MGN) replicates EC2 instances between Regions as well as from on premises. DMS (B) migrates databases, DataSync (C) moves files, and Migration Hub (D) tracks status.

questions.question: A company needs to block SQL injection attacks. Which AWS service or feature provides this functionality?
questions.explanation: AWS WAF inspects HTTP requests with SQL-injection match rules to block attacks. NACLs (B) and security groups (C) filter network packets, and Trusted Advisor (D) checks best practices.

questions.question: A company wants to run its application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs to keep the application on-premises to meet a compliance requirement. Which AWS offering will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Outposts runs EC2 workloads on AWS racks inside your own facility for compliance-bound applications. Dedicated Instances (A) still run in AWS Regions, CloudFront (B) caches content, and Fargate (C) runs containers.

questions.question: A company wants to connect its supported AWS services and VPCs. The company does not want to expose its internal traffic to the public internet. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS PrivateLink connects VPCs and supported services privately without traversing the public internet. Inspector (A) scans vulnerabilities, Connect (C) is a contact center, and internet gateways (D) expose subnets publicly.

questions.question: Which AWS service can manage permissions for AWS resources by using policies?
questions.explanation: IAM manages permissions for AWS resources through identity- and resource-based policies. Inspector (A) scans vulnerabilities, Detective (B) investigates security, and GuardDuty (D) detects threats.

questions.question: A company needs to run some of its workload in the AWS Cloud. The company needs to keep some of the workload in its own on-site data center due to compliance reasons. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Outposts keeps compliance-bound workloads on premises while extending identical AWS APIs to the cloud. Config (A) audits resources, Lightsail (B) bundles VPS instances, and Connect (D) is a contact center.

questions.question: A company wants to deploy an application that stores data in a relational database. The company wants database tasks, such as automated backups and database snapshots, to be managed by AWS. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS manages relational databases with automated backups and snapshots. DocumentDB (A) is document-oriented, EBS (C) attaches block storage, and S3 (D) stores objects.

questions.question: A company that operates on-premises servers decides to start a new line of business. The company determines that additional servers are required for the new workloads. Which advantage of cloud computing can help the company to provision additional infrastructure as quickly as possible?
options: Benefit from massive economies of scale
Trade fixed expense for variable expense
questions.explanation: Speed and agility provision new servers in minutes versus weeks of procurement. Economies of scale (A) cut cost, fixed-to-variable expense (C) changes pricing, and global reach (D) expands geography.
